heading: Brewers procuring beer from other brewers
lead: A brewer, under such regulations as the Secretary shall prescribe, may obtain beer in his own hogsheads, barrels, and kegs, marked with his name and address, from another brewer, with taxpayment thereof to be by the producer in the manner prescribed by section 5054.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 5413, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 675, consisted of provisions similar to those comprising this section, prior to the general revision of this chapter by Pub. L. 85–859.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1976—Pub. L. 94–455 struck out “or his delegate” after “Secretary”.
